text.autoconfig.emi_discovery.title: EMI Discovery
text.autoconfig.emi_discovery.option.ena: When disabled, all discovery restrictions are lifted and EMI operates in standard mode.
When enabled, undiscovered fluids are hidden or blacked out.
When disabled, all fluids are considered discovered and visible.
When enabled, undiscovered status effects are hidden or blacked out.
When disabled, all status effects are considered discovered and visible.
text.autoconfig.emi_discovery.option.fil: When enabled, undiscovered items are hidden from EMI's index and search sidebar.
When disabled, all items remain visible in the index, while recipe tree filtering still applies.
text.autoconfig.emi_discovery.option.dis: When enabled, items you haven't held yet will still appear in EMI's index sidebar
if all of their required ingredients and crafting requirements have already been discovered.
text.autoconfig.emi_discovery.option.req: When enabled, craftable items only appear in the index if you have also
discovered the required workstation (e.g., Crafting Table, Furnace, Loom).
text.autoconfig.emi_discovery.option.dis: When enabled, recipes show even if you have not yet discovered the required workstation.
When disabled, recipes remain hidden until you discover the station used to craft them.
text.autoconfig.emi_discovery.option.req: When enabled, recipes requiring catalysts (such as smithing templates or brewing fuel)
will require that catalyst to be discovered before revealing the recipe.
text.autoconfig.emi_discovery.option.all: Allow Recipe Lookup on Undiscovered Items
When enabled, pressing the recipe key (R) or clicking on undiscovered/blacked-out
items in recipe trees will look up recipes to craft that item.
Allow Usage Lookup on Undiscovered Items
When enabled, pressing the usage key (U) or right-clicking on undiscovered/blacked-out
items will look up what recipes that item can be used in.
text.autoconfig.emi_discovery.option.bla: Black Out Unknown Items in Recipes
When enabled, recipes with undiscovered items are displayed using black silhouettes
instead of hiding the recipe from the view entirely.
text.autoconfig.emi_discovery.option.obs: When enabled, hover tooltips on undiscovered/blacked-out items display '???'.
When disabled, full item names and properties remain visible on hover.
text.autoconfig.emi_discovery.option.sho: When enabled, a distinct '?' icon is rendered in the bottom-right corner
of blacked-out item silhouettes to make undiscovered items easy to identify.
text.autoconfig.emi_discovery.option.ena: When enabled, completing advancements unlocks items and tags
